newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African rand ends weaker, but off worst levels.
newsitem.headline: S.African rand ends weaker, but off worst levels.

text.p: 1405 GMT - Rand ends weaker on importer dollar demand and short-covering. Off worst levels on exporter supply. Bonds a touch softer on rand jitters and amid a lack of interest.

* Rand finishes at 4.5250/5300 from 4.5100/50 close on Wednesday. Dealers say steady importer demand below 4.50 level, briefly broken in morning, drives rand softer. Cross-rates also lure importers. Reserve Bank presence felt above 4.53.

* Key R150 bond last at 15.210 pct from 15.185 at 1400 GMT on Wednesday amid absence of institutional, foreign involvement. No hoped for boost from U.S. gilts market which steady after jobless data unchanged. (DETAILS/BACKGROUND TO FOLLOW)
